subject: Complex numbers
title: Meeting i: Arithmetic with a + bi
subtitle: Adding, multiplying and raising to powers with i, from the first calculation to Gaussian integers and the two-squares theorem.
prerequisite_note: Chapter 1, expanding brackets and the binomial theorem. University sections also use divisibility and remainders.
objectives: Add, subtract and multiply in standard form without errors.
Reduce powers of i and sum runs of powers.
Compute powers of 1 + i and 1 + ω by finding a real power.
Turn binomial sums into real and imaginary parts, including the roots-of-unity filter.
Work with norms, units, primes and division with remainder in the Gaussian integers.
Prove the two-squares theorem for primes and find the squares.
Represent complex numbers as 2×2 real matrices and compute with Pauli matrices.

theorems.statement: an odd prime is a sum of two squares iff p ≡ 1 mod 4

quantum_links.summary: Pauli matrix products XY = iZ etc.; multiplying amplitudes by i leaves probabilities unchanged.
